Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original creature portrait sprite for a 2D creature-raising game
Primary request: Create exactly one full-body creature following the complete independent brief below. This is a new design; do not base it on any existing character.
Management only, do not render text: sm-scaled-014 / ダンコルペ / 鱗体 (scaled)
Body and exact anatomy: 体節1の低い角丸直方体型。脚4、腕0、目2、翼0、尾2。尾は後端左右の短い階段形の板。
Materials and biological motif: 角の丸い厚い四角うろこ。背は前低後高の段差3段。
Primary, secondary, accent colors respectively: #B5C4C3; #ECD3B8; #53677A
Three mandatory visual identifiers: 横に長い低い角丸箱型; 背面に大きく明瞭な段差3段; 後端左右に同寸の階段形板尾2枚
Pose: 正面を低くし、背の3段が横から見える向きで立つ。
Temperament to convey through expression or posture: 几帳面。平たい石のくぼみで体を安定させる。. If the brief specifies zero eyes or no face, do not invent eyes or facial features; express temperament through posture only.
Style: cohesive hand-drawn 2D fantasy game illustration, clear dark colored contour, restrained three-step cel shading, soft upper-left lighting, appealing natural creature proportions, clean readable form.
Composition: isolated single creature, full body; by default use a slight top-down three-quarter view facing toward image-right. If the individual pose explicitly requires a front or top view, that explicit pose takes priority. Preserve the specified pose and physical left/right features. Centered in a square canvas, no cropping. Keep transparent padding on all sides. Intended final canvas is 1024 by 1024 pixels, with the longest creature extent about 768–896 pixels and at least 64 pixels of clear padding.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no painted checkerboard, no backdrop, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no diffuse glow. Habitat, rocks, water surfaces and action scenery mentioned in the brief describe only body posture or temperament; do not render those objects or environments.
Constraints: preserve exact anatomy, all three identifiers and the position of the palette colors; no costume or held tool unless explicitly part of the brief.
Individual forbidden changes: 鋭い箱の角; さいころ模様; 段差のない丸い背
Avoid: extra creatures, humans, text, letters, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative frame, gradients bleeding into the transparent area, photorealism, 3D render, imitation of an existing character.
新しい独自個体のゲーム用全身通常絵。既存の別個体の胴や丸魚鱗の構造をコピーせず、この仕様の形を優先する。濃く丸い輪郭線・穏やかな少数の影色・明瞭な色面、材質差は保つ。全身が透明背景の中央に余白付きで入る。寸法調整は原本を保持して完全透明余白切りと比例縮小で行うので、欠けや描かれた市松背景を使わない。左右後端の同寸短い階段形板尾2枚と、前低後高の背面段差3段を明瞭化。低い横長丸角直方体胴1、脚4の全先端が見える浅い俯角の斜め横向き。目2/腕翼0。厚い丸角四角鱗で覆う。丸い背や4段目/サイコロ柄を描かない。 参照構造図がある場合その文字/番号/白黒配色/白背景を完成絵に描かず、本物の透明alphaにする。
TARGETED REPAIR:
Edit the supplied creature only. Preserve its single low rounded box body, exactly THREE ascending roof steps, two same-sized short stair-plate tails at the rear, two eyes, thick rounded-square scales and colors. The current image reveals only three feet. Change the viewing angle to slightly more overhead and draw the missing far-side rear leg attached under the rear right body edge, with its rounded foot sticking out clearly to the image upper-right beside the highest rear body tier. There must be EXACTLY FOUR separate attached short legs, every foot tip visible and separated in silhouette: nearfront,farfront,nearrear,farrear. Keep all THREE correct existing legs, add only the fourth, no arms or wings. Real transparent background, whole body with padding.
